Title: Clam Fossils in Tennessee — Part 1
Content: Students went on a fossil hunting trip in western Tennessee. They saw a fossil in the layers of a rock cliff near a stream. Figure `1` shows the place where they saw this fossil.

The students learned that the fossil is a clam. This type of clam is no longer found on Earth. However, a similar living species of clam can be found in some places on Earth. Figure `2` shows the clam fossil species and the living clam species.
The students learn that scientists have compared the clam fossil found in Tennessee to the living clam. Table `1` gives information about the clam fossil species and the living clam species.
